title: SDK onboarding pipeline standup - onboarding checklist and handoff notes
content:
Meeting: SDK Onboarding Pipeline Standup
Date: 2026-06-02 (notes updated 2026-06-03)
Attendees: Maya (owner), Liam, Sofia, Chen, Jordan, Ruth (PM by exception)
Duration: 25m (sync + followups)

Purpose and context:
- Quick sync to align final tasks before handing the SDK onboarding pipeline (quickstarts + sample apps + docs) to Solutions Eng for the beta cohort next week.
- Focus: blockers that could stop new users from finishing the "First App" quickstart in <15 minutes.

Top-level goals for this sprint
- Stabilize the CLI quickstart flow (token handling, env var detection) so retries work reliably.
- Finish 2 sample apps (Node chat demo + Python embeddings demo) with test coverage for the most common errors.
- Docs: reduce steps in Getting Started from 12 to 7 by collapsing optional config into an "Advanced" section.

Round-robin updates (short)
- Maya: finalized the quickstart script to detect common proxy envs; still seeing intermittent 502 when browser-based redirect back to CLI occurs. Filed follow-up.
  - Action: attach retry wrapper to redirect handler (Maya / due 6/04).
- Liam: sample Node chat demo now uses the SDK streaming helper; found that ttfb spikes on mac M1 when caching disabled. Reproduced in CI with a smaller model.
  - Blocker: timing flakiness in CI causing flaky tests. Proposal: add deterministic mocking for network and cache layer in unit tests. (Liam -> create PR with mocks by 6/05).
- Sofia: Docs restructure draft uploaded to confluence; trimmed the quickstart to the essentials and added short troubleshooting FAQ. Needs review for accuracy on Dedicated config.
  - Request: product review from Jordan for Dedicated wording (Jordan to review by 6/03).
- Chen: finished the metrics hook for quickstarts (emit event when quickstart completes and when user hits a helper command). Working on a small privacy filter to avoid tokens in logs.
  - Note: metrics schema uses analytics.v1/quickstart.complete. Add mapping to Console dashboards before launch. (Chen -> sync with Observability).
- Jordan: Verified Solutions Eng wants a "one-click" export of the sample app for internal demos. Looking at packaging options (zip vs repo template).
  - Decision needed: do we include prebuilt model weights pointers or only model names? (defer to runtime team for licensing).
- Ruth: flagged that beta customers expect SSO-friendly quickstarts. Ops needs a note describing how to create a test service account.
  - Action: Ruth will draft a short guide for the Customer Success team by 6/07.

Blockers and risks
- CI flakiness for Node streaming tests (Liam) — causes false negatives that block release approval. Mitigation: mock network, run deterministic unit tests, and move integration tests to separate job.
- 502 on redirect back to CLI (Maya) — high severity for onboarding flow. Quickfix: retry wrapper; Medium-term: investigate proxy configuration in the hosted API that affects redirect responses.
- Metrics privacy filter not complete (Chen) — must ensure no PII or token leakage in telemetry before enabling auto-reporting.
- License ambiguity for sample packaging (Jordan) — cannot bundle certain model files; need legal confirmation.

Decisions made during the standup
- Keep Getting Started focused on hosted flow by default; include a prominent "Private/Dedicated setup" callout linking to an Advanced doc. Reduces cognitive load for new devs. (Agreed)
- Add minimal telemetry event set for quickstart completion; telemetry will be opt-in for beta users. Implementation gated on privacy filter. (Agreed)

Action items (owners and due dates)
- Maya: add retry wrapper to redirect handler and run manual validation of browser+CLI flow (due 2026-06-04).
- Liam: PR for deterministic mocks in Node tests + mark flaky tests as quarantined in CI pipeline (due 2026-06-05).
- Sofia: incorporate Jordan's Dedicated wording feedback and push a docs pass to confluence (due 2026-06-03).
- Chen: finish privacy filter for metrics and stub dashboard mapping (due 2026-06-06).
- Jordan: choose packaging approach and confirm with legal about model artifacts (initial recommendation due 2026-06-04).
- Ruth: draft internal guide for SSO/service account creation for Customer Success (due 2026-06-07).

Notes for follow-up meeting
- DevExp handoff call with Solutions Eng scheduled 2026-06-08 10am PT. Expect demo: Node chat quickstart + Python embeddings quickstart + docs tour.
- Bring a short runbook listing common failure modes and recovery steps (Maya + Chen).
- Confirm dashboard tile for quickstart completions (Chen to sync with Observability).

Loose ideas / brainstorming captured during the call (informal)
- Could we add a tiny onboarding checklist card in the Console that shows "Complete quickstart" progress? Low friction, high signal for conversion.
- Consider a "sandbox" mode that pre-fills ephemeral API keys for demo accounts (requires policy review).
- Create a one-page "What to expect in first 15 minutes" that we can include in marketing emails to beta cohort.

Appendix: quick references cited in standup
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 (Liam's streaming helper adjustments)
- Jira: JIRA-ENG-1298 (Quickstart retry redirect investigation)
- Confluence draft: Quickstart-onboarding-checklist-v2 (Sofia)

Status summary (one-liner)
- On track for beta handoff, but 2 short-term items (redirect retry and CI flakiness) must be completed this week to avoid delaying the demo.

End of notes.
